The user says "make a 10 dollar deposit" but they want to convert 10 dollars to euros first. So we should do two steps: first call currency_conversion to convert 10 USD to EUR. Then call banking_service to deposit 10 USD? Wait, the user said "convert 10 dollars to Euros and make a 10 dollar deposit in my local bank account". That implies they want to convert 10 dollars to euros (maybe to see how many euros they'd get) and also deposit 10 dollars into their local bank account. But the deposit is 10 dollars, not the converted amount. So we need to do two separate calls: one to currency_conversion, one to banking_service.

We have to use the tool calls. We can do them sequentially or concurrently. The user wants both operations. We can do them concurrently or sequentially. Let's do them concurrently. We'll call currency_conversion with amount=10, from_currency="USD", to_currency="EUR". Then call banking_service with account_id="987654", amount=10. We'll produce two function calls.
